newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit down on dollar's strength vs majors.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit down on dollar's strength vs majors.

text.p: The ringgit eased throughout the day as the dollar gained heavily against other major currencies, dealers said on Monday.
They said dollar/ringgit was facing resistance at 2.5250, which if broken could trigger stop-loss selling.
"There is a lot of dollar shortcovering, year-end demand and bullish technicals pulling the ringgit down," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank in Kuala Lumpur.
He said dealers still believed ringgit would decline from its current level due to commercial dollar demand ahead of the year-end.
Dealers said the support at 2.5250 was also due to some selling of Singapore dollars against the ringgit.

"Whenever the Singapore dollar is above 1.8 ringgit, there tends to be a bit of selling off," another dealer said. At 0900 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5243/50 a dollar against 2.5194/04 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Friday. It was at 1.8006/20 per Singapore dollar against 1.7980/00.
